_comment: Known plug-and-play violations, recorded 2026-07-25 when check-integration-conformance
landed. This is the FIX BACKLOG, not a mute list: every entry is printed on every build,
and an entry that no longer reproduces fails the build so the list can only shrink.
Do NOT add entries to silence a new violation — fix the declaration or the runtime path.

known.note: Steers at the claude.ai Google Calendar MCP connector, which does not exist on Grok/Ollama/GPT. Fix: describe the local calendar honestly and drop the vendor routing.
Tells the model to prefer the Gmail MCP tool. On any non-Anthropic model that tool is absent, so this suppresses the portable IMAP path the user actually configured.
Same as email_read, on the send path.

Declares authType api_key but 5 of 6 endpoints are user-scoped (Gmail/Calendar/Drive) and require OAuth2 user context. Only /youtube/v3/search works with an API key — /api/integrations/test already hardcodes YouTube as the probe, which is the tell. Decision pending: split a youtube integration out, or implement OAuth2.

Empty baseUrl with smtp/imap pseudo-paths. The email_* tools are the real runtime path; the endpoints are config-UI labels. Fix: declare the transport explicitly instead of leaving it shaped like a broken HTTP integration.

authInstructions ask for 9 values; the install modal renders one field and the route persists only SMTP_PASS. IMAP_PASS is resolved at runtime but can never be stored this way. email_setup is the only working config path. Fix: make Settings drive email_setup, or give the integration a multi-field credential schema.
